candidates.source_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (Official Gazette / Službeni list) — GZK portal
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative full text of every Kosovo law and sub-legal act, including the banking law (Nr. 04/L-093), the payment system law (Nr. 04/L-155) and successor payment-services legislation. Portal exposes advanced search by title, keyword, content, date, act type and issuing institution, and serves acts in sq/sr/en/tr/bs — so the same law can be tracked across languages. This is the legal ground truth against which every institutional or regulator announcement should be reconciled.
candidates.legal_status: official state publication, public domain legal text
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of ActDocumentDetail.aspx?ActID=NNNN pages plus the new-acts index; watch for act IDs in the banking/payments range and diff consolidated texts. ASP.NET postback search may require form-state handling — prefer stable ActID deep links harvested from BQK and Assembly citations.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) on law title + snowballing ActID links cited in BQK regulations
queries_used: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës ligji për bankat institucionet mikrofinanciare
Službeni list Republike Kosovo zakon o bankama mikrofinansijskim institucijama gzk

candidates.source_name: Kuvendi i Kosovës — Draft laws register (Projektligjet)
candidates.why_relevant: Per-draft-law pages (?draftlaw=NNN) track a bill through first reading, committee amendments, reports and adoption, with attached PDFs. This is the earliest formal, citable point at which a change to banking or payment-services law becomes visible — typically months before banks or PSPs comment publicly. Mirrors exist on assembly-kosova.org and assemblyofkosovo.org.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate/monitor ?draftlaw=N IDs, extract title, sponsor, status timeline and attached PDFs; keyword-filter titles for pagesa/banka/financiar/tatim.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for projektligji + snowball from committee news items
queries_used: Kuvendi i Kosovës Komisioni për Ekonomi Industri projektligji raport dëgjim publik
Kuvendi i Kosovës projektligji për shërbimet e pagesave 2025 miratimi

candidates.source_name: Kuvendi i Kosovës — Komisioni për Buxhet, Punë dhe Transfere / Buxhet e Financa (committee page)
candidates.why_relevant: The budget/finance committee is the functional committee for the payment-services and banking bills and reviews public debt, fiscal policy and the annual budget report; its agendas, minutes and reports name the ministers, BQK officials and industry bodies invited. Committee-level reporting is where a bill's substantive amendments first appear.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll ?committee=NN committee pages for agendas/minutes/reports; cross-reference with the Assembly calendar for upcoming sittings.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for komisioni buxheti dhe financat + procesverbal
queries_used: Kuvendi i Kosovës transkript seanca plenare procesverbal komisioni buxheti dhe financat

candidates.source_name: Kuvendi i Kosovës — Komisioni për Ekonomi, Industri, Ndërmarrësi dhe Tregti
candidates.why_relevant: Runs public hearings (dëgjime publike) on economy bills and explicitly invites BQK, the Kosovo Banking Association (Shoqata e Bankave), the Chamber of Commerce, the Competition Authority and the EU Office — the hearing invite lists themselves are a ready-made actor map for the sector, and hearing coverage records industry positions verbatim.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the committee news feed (/shq/punesimi/per-publikun/lajmi/...) and extract participant lists as actor-map input.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for dëgjim publik + committee
queries_used: Kuvendi i Kosovës Komisioni për Ekonomi Industri projektligji raport dëgjim publik

candidates.source_name: Kuvendi i Kosovës — Kalendari (sitting calendar) and plenary/transcript archive
candidates.why_relevant: Forward-looking calendar of plenary and committee sittings gives lead time on when a banking/payments bill will be debated; the site also carries plenary transcript/proceedings archives for older legislatures. Best used as a scheduling pointer that routes the collector to the right committee and draft-law pages.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily poll of the calendar page; queue agenda items matching sector keywords for same-week follow-up.
queries_used: Kuvendi i Kosovës transkript seanca plenare procesverbal komisioni buxheti dhe financat

candidates.source_name: Platforma e Konsultimeve Publike (public consultation platform, Office of the Prime Minister / Zyra për Qeverisje të Mirë)
candidates.why_relevant: Single mandatory entry point (Rregullore 05/2016 on minimum public-consultation standards) for every draft law, concept document and strategy before it reaches government/Assembly. Publishes the draft text, the consultation document, submitted comments and the institution's responses — the earliest verifiable signal of a coming banking/payments rule change, typically months ahead of the gazette. Trilingual (sq/en/sr).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate viewConsult.php?ConsultationID=NNNNN and the listing pages; filter by proposing institution (MFPT, MINT) and by keywords pagesa/bankar/financiar/tatim; capture attached draft PDFs and comment matrices.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for platforma e konsultimeve publike
queries_used: konsultimet.rks-gov.net platforma konsultimi publik projektligj

candidates.source_name: Ministria e Financave, Punës dhe Transfereve (MFPT) — main site
candidates.why_relevant: Sponsoring ministry for the banking, payment-services and tax bills; publishes press releases, legislative initiatives, budget documents and macro-fiscal material. The minister's statements on the payment-services bill (e.g. cost reduction, SEPA alignment) originate here before being echoed by media.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl news/press list plus page.aspx?id= section indexes; note the site appears to exist under two hostnames (mf.rks-gov.net and mfpt.rks-gov.net) — resolve and dedupe.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for ministria e financave + thesari
queries_used: Ministria e Financave Punës dhe Transfereve Kosovë thesari sistemi i pagesave
Ministria e Financave Kosovë buletini i borxhit publik raportet mujore mf.rks-gov.net
local_language_terms_used: Ministria e Financave, Punës dhe Transfereve

candidates.why_relevant: The Treasury operates the government payment execution chain (including a Division for Payment Administration), the single treasury account and the government banking relationships — i.e. the state's own payments infrastructure and the counterparty for commercial banks handling public-sector flows. Treasury notices (salary/pension execution dates, account changes) are direct operational signals about government payment rails.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the Thesari section tree (/Thesari/Page/NNN) and monthly financial reports; supplement with the ministry's Facebook feed, which carries Treasury execution notices verbatim.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for thesari + sistemi i pagesave
queries_used: Ministria e Financave Punës dhe Transfereve Kosovë thesari sistemi i pagesave

candidates.source_name: MFPT monthly/annual fiscal and public-debt reporting (raportet financiare, borxhi publik)
candidates.why_relevant: Monthly reports on revenues, expenditures and borrowing, plus macroeconomic bulletins and public-enterprise financial statements. Domestic government securities issuance is the main local capital-market activity and directly shapes bank balance sheets and liquidity — a core structural indicator for the banking cell.
candidates.access_status: public; exact publication index page not confirmed in this pass
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Locate the publications index under mf.rks-gov.net and harvest PDF series monthly; cross-check the securities auction calendar against BQK data.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for buletini i borxhit publik
queries_used: Ministria e Financave Kosovë buletini i borxhit publik raportet mujore mf.rks-gov.net

candidates.source_name: Administrata Tatimore e Kosovës (ATK / TAK) — Legjislacioni
candidates.why_relevant: Tax Administration publishes the consolidated tax legislation, administrative instructions and public explanatory notices. Directly relevant to payments because fiscalisation, electronic invoicing, cash-transaction thresholds and rules on transactions with fictitious/inactive businesses shape card-vs-cash behaviour and POS/fiscal-device demand. Law Nr. 08/L-257 on tax procedures (in force 28 Jan 2024) is the current base act.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the legislation index and the njoftime/notification feed; diff administrative instructions (udhëzime administrative) against gazette versions.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for ATK legjislacioni + njoftime
queries_used: Administrata Tatimore e Kosovës ATK njoftime legjislacioni tatimor

candidates.source_name: Zyra Kombëtare e Auditimit (National Audit Office) — audit reports
candidates.why_relevant: Supreme audit institution (Law Nr. 05/L-055) publishing every individual and annual audit report, including financial, compliance, performance and IT audits of the Treasury's controls and of MFPT. Audit findings expose weaknesses in government payment systems and budget execution that no institution discloses voluntarily — high-value indirect intelligence, and reports also carry management action plans.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest the report repository (cms/ReportFiles/ and cms/uploads/ PDF paths) and the ActionPlansDetails pages; filter by audited entity = MFPT/Thesari.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for raporti i auditimit + Thesari
queries_used: Zyra Kombëtare e Auditimit Kosovë raporti auditimit Thesari pasqyrat financiare

candidates.source_name: Zyra e Kryeministrit / Qeveria e Kosovës — draft laws and decisions repository
candidates.why_relevant: Government-approved draft laws are posted as PDFs here before transmission to the Assembly — the payment-services draft law PDF was published under kryeministri.rks-gov.net/wp-content/uploads/. Also carries government decisions, strategies (e.g. the Public Finance Management Strategy) and per-ministry news categories, giving the executive-side view weeks ahead of parliamentary registration.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the ministry news category feeds plus the wp-content/uploads PDF space (WordPress — use the site's search and sitemap rather than blind enumeration).
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowballed from search hit on the payment-services draft law PDF
queries_used: Kuvendi i Kosovës projektligji për shërbimet e pagesave 2025 miratimi
local_language_terms_used: Strategjia e Menaxhimit të Financave Publike

candidates.source_name: Njësia për Inteligjencë Financiare e Kosovës (FIU-K) — annual reports and typologies
candidates.why_relevant: Independent state AML/CFT body publishing annual reports, suspicious-transaction statistics, sectoral ML risk assessments (including one specifically on risk in bank products offered in Kosovo) and typology reports produced with UNDP. These impose compliance obligations on banks and PSPs and reveal where payment channels are considered high-risk.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest the publications/reports section and wp-content/uploads PDFs annually; pair with Council of Europe MONEYVAL/PECK assessment reports for external validation.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sq) for NJIF raporti vjetor
queries_used: Njësia e Inteligjencës Financiare Kosovë FIU raporti vjetor pastrimi i parave

candidates.source_name: GZK — Serbian-language act texts (Službeni list Republike Kosovo)
candidates.why_relevant: Serbian-language official versions of the same laws (e.g. ZAKON BR. 08/L-304 O BANKAMA) are legally equivalent and are the version cited by Serbian-language media and by banks serving Serb-majority municipalities. Needed for sr-language monitoring and for matching entity/term variants (banka, platne usluge, mikrofinansijske institucije).
candidates.access_status: public; language switch parameter not independently confirmed in this pass
candidates.suggested_collection_method: For each tracked ActID, fetch the sr and en variants alongside sq and store as parallel texts; BQK mirrors Serbian versions of banking law and regulations as a fallback.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search (sr) for zakon o bankama + Službeni list
queries_used: Službeni list Republike Kosovo zakon o bankama mikrofinansijskim institucijama gzk

candidates.source_name: BQK legal-framework repository as a mirror of gazetted banking/payments law (korniza ligjore)
candidates.why_relevant: Outside this cell's primary remit (the regulator has its own cell) but functionally the most reliable, well-organised mirror of gazetted banking and payment law in sq/sr/en, with each regulation citing its enabling law article. Useful as a cross-check when GZK deep links move, and as a seed list of ActIDs to track in the gazette.
candidates.source_subtype: regulator document repository (used here as legal mirror)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest wp-content/uploads and repository/docs/korniza_ligjore PDF trees; parse the enabling-law citation in each regulation's preamble to build a law-to-regulation graph.
queries_used: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës ligji për bankat institucionet mikrofinanciare

candidates.source_name: Gjykata Kushtetuese e Kosovës (Constitutional Court) — judgments on financial-sector laws
candidates.why_relevant: The Court has struck down a batch of adopted laws — reportedly including the Law on Payment Services adopted 5 December 2024 — meaning a gazetted law is not the end state. Judgments are a mandatory reconciliation layer for any legal-change tracking of the payments framework and explain why bills reappear in the Assembly.
candidates.access_status: public; site not directly fetched in this pass — domain inferred from the institution's known portal, treat as unverified
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the judgments/decisions feed and cross-reference case numbers cited in media reports of annulled laws; GZK also publishes court decisions as an act type.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowballed from sq search on the payment-services bill
queries_used: Kuvendi i Kosovës projektligji për shërbimet e pagesave 2025 miratimi

candidates.source_name: MFPT official Facebook page (Ministria e Financave / Republika e Kosovës)
candidates.why_relevant: In practice the ministry publishes Treasury operational notices (salary and student-payment execution dates, Treasury account openings) on Facebook faster and more completely than on the ministry website. Valuable as a low-latency tripwire that points back to official pages, but it is a platform feed, not an archive.
candidates.access_status: login wall / heavy bot defences for automated access
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Do not scrape; if used, access via the official Facebook Graph/Pages API or manual review, and always confirm the item against an rks-gov.net page before recording it.
queries_used: Ministria e Financave Punës dhe Transfereve Kosovë thesari sistemi i pagesave

candidates.why_relevant: Government statistical agency whose wage, household income and business demography series are the denominator for any banking penetration or payments-adoption estimate, and are cited in ministry impact assessments. Publications are served from an API-backed document endpoint (askapi.rks-gov.net), which suggests machine-readable access.
candidates.access_status: public; askapi.rks-gov.net serves publication PDFs — API contract not confirmed in this pass
candidates.legal_status: official statistics, generally reusable with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the agency's data/API endpoints over PDF scraping; register series of interest (wages, prices, business register) for scheduled pulls.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Albanian for Assembly plenary and committee verbatim transcripts (transkript, procesverbal). Results pointed to a general archive area of kuvendikosoves.org covering older legislature periods (2001-2007, 2007-2019) but no current, dated, machine-addressable transcript index was located for the present legislature.
negative_findings.result_summary: Committee and plenary activity is currently observable mainly through news items and calendar entries rather than a structured transcript feed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Committee minutes are the cell's stated highest-value early-warning artefact; without a stable transcript endpoint, collection must fall back on news items, which are editorially summarised and drop speaker-level detail.

negative_findings.description: The Assembly appears under at least three hostnames (kuvendikosoves.org, assembly-kosova.org, assemblyofkosovo.org) and the finance ministry under two (mf.rks-gov.net, mfpt.rks-gov.net), with overlapping and possibly divergent content and path schemes.
negative_findings.result_summary: Same draft-law and committee IDs resolve under multiple hosts; canonical host not established in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Risks duplicate records, broken monitors when one host is retired, and false 'dead source' verdicts during liveness checks.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom or documented bulk/API endpoint for newly published acts was found on gzk.rks-gov.net; the portal exposes an ASP.NET search UI and per-act ActID pages only.
negative_findings.result_summary: New-act detection will likely need scheduled scraping of index pages or ActID range probing rather than a subscription feed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Determines the engineering cost and latency of the single most authoritative source in this cell.

negative_findings.description: GZK advertises Turkish and Bosnian act versions alongside sq/sr/en, but this run's language scope was sq/sr/en so no queries were run with Turkish or Bosnian banking/payments terminology.
negative_findings.result_summary: No candidates assessed in tr or bs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Minor for market intelligence, but relevant if entity-name matching needs all official transliterations.

negative_findings.description: Media reporting indicates the Constitutional Court annulled the Law on Payment Services adopted 5 December 2024, but the judgment itself was not retrieved from gjk-ks.org in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Court judgment recorded as an unverified hypothesis; the gjk-ks.org candidate carries a reduced confidence score accordingly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The legal status of Kosovo's payment-services framework is the single most consequential fact in this cell and must not be recorded from media alone.

coverage_gaps.description: Kosovo Customs (Dogana e Kosovës) and the Kosovo Business Registration Agency (ARBK, under MINT) were not searched, though both are government disclosure bodies: customs for cross-border payment and cash-declaration data, ARBK for entity registration and beneficial ownership of PSPs and fintechs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run sq/sr queries on 'Dogana e Kosovës deklarimi i parave të gatshme' and 'ARBK regjistri i biznesit pronari përfitues' and assess both as direct sources.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language coverage in this cell rests on one query and on BQK's Serbian mirrors; no Serbian-language search was run against the Assembly (Skupština Republike Kosovo) committee or draft-law pages, nor against the consultation platform's Serbian interface.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run sr queries such as 'Skupština Kosova nacrt zakona o platnim uslugama', 'komisija za budžet i finansije Kosovo zapisnik', and 'Platforma Javnih Konsultacija nacrt zakona'.

coverage_gaps.description: No regulatory impact assessment (Vlerësimi i Ndikimit Rregullator / Koncept Dokument) was located specifically for banking or payment-services legislation, although the consultation platform is the designated home for them.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search the consultation platform by proposing institution MFPT and by 'koncept dokument pagesa/bankar' to pull the RIA documents, which contain cost estimates and market-structure assumptions unavailable elsewhere.

coverage_gaps.description: Publication cadence, archive depth and history retention were not established for any of the government sources — unknown how far back consultation records, committee reports or Treasury notices remain retrievable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each priority source, sample the oldest retrievable item and record archive depth and update frequency before designing the collection schedule; register key pages with a web archive as insurance.

coverage_gaps.description: Kosovo's access-to-public-documents regime (right-to-information requests to MFPT, ATK, Treasury) was not explored as a collection channel for material not proactively published, such as committee working papers or Treasury banking arrangements.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess the 'Ligji për qasje në dokumente publike' request route and each institution's designated officer as a documented, legal fallback channel.

brief: Kosovo's government and parliamentary disclosure layer is unusually well-centralised for a small jurisdiction: the GZK official gazette (gzk.rks-gov.net) carries the authoritative multilingual text of every banking and payments act, while the mandatory public-consultation platform (konsultimet.rks-gov.net) and the Assembly's per-bill draft-law pages give a documented pipeline that runs months ahead of gazette publication and years ahead of institutional commentary. The finance ministry (MFPT/Treasury), Tax Administration, National Audit Office and the Financial Intelligence Unit round out the fiscal and compliance side, with the NAO's Treasury IT and compliance audits and the FIU's bank-product risk assessments providing findings no institution would disclose voluntarily. The two material risks for this cell are structural rather than legal: hostname fragmentation (three Assembly domains, two ministry domains) that will corrupt liveness checks and deduplication, and the absence of any feed/API on the gazette, which pushes new-act detection onto scheduled scraping. A further substantive caveat is that gazettement is not final — media report that the Constitutional Court annulled the December 2024 Law on Payment Services, so court judgments must be tracked as a reconciliation layer over the gazette rather than treated as an optional extra.
